publisher.name: FinanceRateCalc
publisher.description: Independent analysis of the public federal HMDA record and of official mortgage reports. No ads, no affiliates, no lender money.

rule: Every statement here is built from receipted claims only, and each receipt is checked against the record when this file is built. A statement without a receipt is not listed here; it is in citable-queue.json with safe_to_cite false.
license: CC BY 4.0. Cite with the receipt: it lets a reader check the figure and see if it was later corrected.
dataset_basis: CFPB/FFIEC HMDA public record 2025, FHA (loan_type 2), decisioned applications (action_taken 1, 2, 3), reverse mortgages excluded.

statistics.text: In 2025, 22.1% of decisioned FHA applications reported under HMDA were denied (all reporting lenders, reverse mortgages excluded).

reproduce.how_to_reproduce: Recipes for the headline figures, with expected results and the usual pitfalls, are published at https://financeratecalc.com/verify.html and machine-readably at https://financeratecalc.com/data/verify.json.
reproduce.universe: loan_type=2 (FHA forward), action_taken in (1,2,3), reverse mortgages (HECM) excluded
reproduce.if_you_get_a_different_number: Tell us: ziyetis@gmail.com. A figure we cannot reproduce goes in the public corrections log, dated, with credit to whoever found it.
reproduce.api: CFPB/FFIEC HMDA Data Browser API, no key
reproduce.filters: Keep loan_type=2 (FHA), action_taken in (1,2,3) as decisioned, reverse_mortgage != 1; denial = action_taken 3. The API has no reverse-mortgage filter: drop those rows yourself.
reproduce.note: outcome shares use action_taken 1-5 as the base; the denial rate uses 1-3

limitations: A historical aggregate of decisioned FHA applications (originated, approved not accepted, denied), 2025; not a prediction for any one application.

statistics.text: Among these eleven large FHA lenders, 2025 denial rates ranged from 6.2% (CrossCountry Mortgage) to 52.8% (NewRez).
